# Module Logic Template

Use this template to document internal module logic.

1) Overview
- Short summary of the module purpose.

2) Tables / Models
- List of primary tables and key model fields.

3) Services involved
- List services (with file paths) and a short description of responsibilities.

4) Key flows (step-by-step)
- Describe important flows (onboarding, package assignment, document upload) as numbered steps.

5) Permissions / Middleware
- Any route/middleware requirements (e.g., auth:admin, SetLocaleFromHeader).

6) Common pitfalls
- Known edge cases and how to handle them.

7) Future improvements
- Suggestions for refactor or enhancements.
